notes: ἐν γαστρὶ ἕξει is split under rule 94's count test, the ASV having written separate words; reading the three tokens as one idiom unit remains defensible. The chapter treats MAT.1.18's ἐν γαστρὶ ἔχουσα the same way, which is rule 24.
ὁ θεός takes no English determiner in *God with us*, so rule 23 empties the article, and the predicate noun is reordered ahead of the prepositional phrase under rule 15.
